_comment: SSRF via OOB — REAL (must CONFIRM with a real interactsh callback). Drives the ssrf_target lab (GET /fetch?url=), which fetches ANY user URL server-side. The detector injects a UNIQUE interactsh domain and CONFIRMS iff the target's server-side fetch triggers an out-of-band callback. Needs OUTBOUND network + a reachable public interactsh server. Boot the lab first: python -m uvicorn ssrf_target.main:app --port 8004. Run: python run.py ssrf --config examples/run.ssrf_real.json
